title: Starters, Rotation, and Minutes Timeline Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: Player_SetMinutes (RVA 0x11b2bb0) writes a 7-bit minutes value (0..127, clamped to 0..48 in business logic) into [PlayerRosterSlot + 0xf8] bits 18..24 using mask 0xfe03ffff and left-shift 18.
claims.falsification_note: Single-player minute modification does not balance team total; caller must ensure 240-minute conservation across roster.

claims.statement: Gameplan contains a full 48-minute rotation timeline structure: boolean flag at GAMEPLAN+0x18c, followed by 48 slices of 5x uint16 player IDs at GAMEPLAN+0x18e..0x36e (480 bytes total).
claims.falsification_note: If GAMEPLAN+0x18c is 0, the game engine uses automated coach rotation logic instead of the timeline.

claims.statement: Starters (slots 0..4) and Second Unit (slots 5..9) are defined by ordered depth chart position, extracted via 0xedf000 (bits 22..25 of [Player+0xf78]).
claims.falsification_note: In-game live substitution requires active game simulation context.
